_meta.title: Swedish national finance constants 2026
_meta.disclaimer: Reference data, not tax advice. Verify against Skatteverket before relying on it.
_meta.note: Headline published figures only. Bracket structures and the rules governing how these interact are not included; see the calculators at https://maclaine.se/en/finance for worked results.

prisbasbelopp.note: Price base amount (prisbasbelopp), the index behind grundavdrag, benefit ceilings and many thresholds.

inkomstbasbelopp.note: Income base amount (inkomstbasbelopp), the index behind pension ceilings and the public service fee cap.

arbetsgivaravgift.note: Standard employer social fee on gross pay. Paid by the employer on top of salary, so total employer cost is salary x 1.3142.

alderspensionsavgift.note: Reduced employer fee (pension component only) for older workers. The age gate itself is not published here.

statligInkomstskatt.note: State income tax: 20% on taxable earned income above the skiktgrans, on top of municipal tax.

allmanPensionsavgift.note: General pension contribution withheld from the employee, fully offset by a tax reduction for most earners.

isk.note: Investeringssparkonto is taxed on a notional yield (schablon), not on realised gains. Effective drag is schablonRate x taxRate. The first 300 000 kr of capital base is exempt from 2026.

kapitalvinstskatt.note: Flat tax on realised capital gains in a taxable account (depa).

schablonmetoden.note: Standard-method cost basis: 20% of sale proceeds for listed shares and funds, usable when the real purchase price is unknown or lower.

publicServiceAvgift.note: Public service fee (radio and TV). 1% of taxable earned income, capped. The cap is per person, not per income source.

rotRut.note: Tax reductions on the labour cost of renovation (ROT) and household services (RUT). The temporary 50% ROT boost expired 2026-01-01. ROT has its own sub-cap inside the combined ceiling.

bolan.note: Mortgage rules. The debt-to-income amortisation surcharge (skarpta amorteringskravet) was abolished 2026-04-01. Interest deduction drops from 30% to 21% on interest above the threshold.

fastighetsavgiftCap.note: Municipal property fee ceiling for a house (smahus).

insattningsgaranti.note: Deposit guarantee per person per bank (Riksgalden).

styrranta.note: Riksbanken policy rate. Point-in-time value, unlike the rest of this file; check the Riksbank for the current rate.
